question: What evidence informs acquisition of nationwide help desk support services?

scope.period: FY2022 through FY2026, with FY2026 identified as partial

document_register.role: Defines service scope and performance standards
document_register.gaps_or_conflicts: Acquisition strategy and final contract type are not approved

user_context: The user stated that nationwide remote support and one on-site transition team are required.
assumptions: NAICS 541513 is a research filter, not an approved NAICS determination.

evidence.title: Example PWS
evidence.fact: The draft scope requires nationwide remote help desk service.

evidence.title: USASpending fixture trend
evidence.fact: The fixture contains three complete fiscal years and one partial fiscal year.
evidence.limitations: Synthetic offline fixture; not a live federal result

evidence.title: User-provided acquisition context
evidence.fact: The user requested analysis but did not approve a set-aside, contract type, or commerciality determination.

evidence.title: Offline obligation sum
evidence.fact: The three complete-year fixture values total 6000000.00.
evidence.limitations: Synthetic values used only for deterministic validation

findings.text: The draft requirement is for nationwide help desk support, but key acquisition-strategy decisions remain pending.
The trend analysis must exclude the partial fiscal year from full-year comparisons.

inferences.text: Additional commercial-market evidence is needed before the report can be called complete.
inferences.reasoning: The offline fixture contains federal and document evidence but no current commercial source.
inferences.uncertainty: High until commercial evidence is gathered

user_decisions: The user approved the research scope but has not made the reserved acquisition decisions.
unresolved_questions: Which acquisition strategy will the Contracting Officer approve after reviewing complete market evidence?

validation.executive_summary: This offline fixture demonstrates evidence traceability and decision boundaries for a help desk market-research draft.
validation.methodology: The fixture separates supplied-document evidence from a synthetic federal-data result and preserves the partial-year limitation.
validation.small_business_analysis: No set-aside conclusion is made. Historical data alone cannot establish the Rule of Two.
validation.pricing_analysis: No contract-type or price-reasonableness determination is made.
